covered_actors: National government and national administrative organs
Research and development institutions (universities, R&D corporations, and other AI R&D bodies)
AI utilizing businesses (developers, providers, and business users of AI-related products or services)
compliance_deadlines: Date of promulgation: entry into force of general provisions (Supplementary Provisions Article 1)
Within 3 months of promulgation (date specified by Cabinet Order): entry into force of Chapters 3 and 4 (AI Basic Plan and AI Strategy Headquarters) and Supplementary Provisions Articles 3 and 4
implementation_notes: Act No. 53 of 2025 (Reiwa 7) is a horizontal statutory framework promoting AI R&D and utilization alongside proper governance. It establishes the Cabinet-level AI Strategy Headquarters (supported by the Cabinet Office) and mandates an AI Basic Plan (Article 18). While utilizing businesses are legally required to cooperate with government measures (Article 7), the Act relies on soft supervisory tools—such as incident investigation, analysis, guidance, advice, and information provision (Article 16)—and contains no statutory fines or criminal penalties. Supplementary Provisions Article 2 requires the government to review implementation status in light of international trends and socioeconomic changes.
